title: Invariant open neighbourhoods inside invariant intersections for affine flat descent
statement:
Let $p:X\to S$ be a flat surjective morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Let $V\to X$ be a scheme, assume $V$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and give it a descent datum $\varphi:V\times_S X\xrightarrow{\sim}X\times_S V$ over $X/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum, def-pc-fibre-product]. For a subset $F\subset |V|$, write $F\times_S X$ for its inverse image under $V\times_S X\to V$ and $X\times_S F$ for its inverse image under $X\times_S V\to V$. Then for every $v\in V$ there exist an open subscheme $W\subset V$ and a subset $E\subset |V|$ such that $v\in W\subset E$, $E$ is an intersection of a nonempty set-indexed family of quasi-compact opens of $V$, and
$$\varphi(W\times_S X)=X\times_S W,\qquad \varphi(E\times_S X)=X\times_S E.$$
The first equality is an equality of open subschemes and the second an equality of subsets.
